modifier.description: Command modifier key (e.g., '^g' for Ctrl+g). See dvtm(1) USAGE section.

delay.description: Delay (ms) ncurses waits before deciding if a character is part of an escape sequence.

scrollback_lines.description: Scrollback history buffer size in lines.

title.description: Static terminal title; if empty, title changes per focused window.

status_fifo.description: Path to named pipe for status bar content (e.g., /run/dvtm-status.fifo).

cmd_fifo.description: Path to named pipe for external command injection.

no_mouse_grab.description: If true, disables mouse grabbing at startup (-M flag).

startup_commands.description: List of commands to execute on startup, each in its own window.
